note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).

value: The landlord must ensure the tenancy agreement is in writing, sign it and give the tenant a copy before the tenancy starts; the tenant must sign it. Failing to do so is an unlawful act and an infringement offence (s 13).
note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).

value: A landlord may require a general bond of no more than 4 weeks' rent; if rent is lawfully increased a further bond up to the increase in 4 weeks' rent may be required. Requiring more is an unlawful act and an infringement offence (s 18).
note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).

value: Requiring key money for granting, continuing, extending, varying or renewing a tenancy, or for an assignment or sub-letting, is prohibited without the Tribunal's consent (s 17).
note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).

value: A landlord must not require rent more than 2 weeks in advance, or before the period already paid has expired (s 23).
note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).

value: Rent may be increased only by written notice stating the new amount and the date it becomes payable, at least 60 days after the notice (28 days for boarding houses); not within 12 months of the tenancy start or the last increase; during a fixed term only if the agreement permits (s 24).
note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).

value: A landlord may end a periodic tenancy in any case by at least 90 days' notice, or at least 42 days' notice if, for example, the owner needs the home as their principal residence for at least 90 days or the owner must give vacant possession to a buyer (s 51(1), (2)).
note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).

value: Sections 25 to 28 and 51 do not apply to a tenancy for a fixed term of 90 days or less if the parties agree in writing before the start that it will not be extended beyond 90 days in total (s 7).
note: Residential Tenancies Act 1986, consolidated version as at 1 December 2025 (English).
